svg.title: Observed Refund Crew failure modes
svg.desc: Three observed, reproducible failure modes from committed evaluation runs.
svg.text: OBSERVED IN THE LAB · NOT HYPOTHETICAL

text.tspan: Orchestration amplifies whatever the model already does
the crew is a corrective for a model that is bad at the task, a tax on a model that is good at it, and catastrophic for a
model whose weakness is handing off (mode 2). Mistral's forbidden refunds got a second reviewer and roughly half were…
Delegation is a handoff, and some models treat handoffs as…
every sub-agent returned successfully. The investigator reported, compliance ruled, and the orchestrator then ended its
turn without calling close_ticket. Not one delegation failed; the transcript shows failed=[] on every pattern.
The brief is a lossy channel, and the loss is invisible to both…
the investigator reports the order facts. The orchestrator forwards those findings to compliance. Neither mentions that a
bank chargeback is already in flight, so compliance rules on the action it was shown and approves a refund it would…

svg.text: Open FAILURE_MODES.md for scenario IDs, evidence, impact, and reproduction commands.
